comprehensive_ml_oxide_dataset.name: Comprehensive ML Oxide Dataset Creation and Training
comprehensive_ml_oxide_dataset.description: Generate a comprehensive dataset of oxide polymorphs from Materials Project and train an XGBoost model to predict formation energies. This task includes: (1) generating a diverse set of oxide compositions, (2) retrieving polymorphs for each composition, (3) consolidating data into ML-ready format, (4) training XGBoost model, and (5) evaluating model performance with cross-validation. The goal is to create a robust ML model that can predict formation energies across diverse oxide materials.
